description: A sleek jet-black panther-like beast crouches facing the viewer, shown full figure at eye level, its head low between its forelegs. Its face is tinted deep blue with glowing green eyes, and its outstretched paws end in long pale claws. From its shoulders sprout two long tentacles, black on top with a bright yellow spotted edge underneath, ending in fringed tips. The background is flat teal, so the black body stands out sharply. The mood is predatory and uncanny. The body stays still while the tentacles move. Frame 1: the upper tentacle lies flat across the top; the lower one curls down to the right. Frame 2: the upper tentacle rises in an arch. Frame 3: the lower tentacle swings left across the chest. Frame 4: it curls further left, yellow side showing. Frame 5: it coils tightly at the left. Frame 6: it begins swinging back. Frame 7: it sweeps toward the right. Frame 8: it uncoils down to the right again. Every frame is extremely brief, so the loop reads as fast, continuous whipping of the tentacles.
title: Panther with whipping tentacles
